title: Chapter 130 Rat Tide
content:
Chapter 130 Rat Tide

The attacks of the one-star defensive earth thorns undulated with each other. The underground ratmen who came up like a tide kept rising and falling under the attacks of the earth thorns, as if they were walking on the waves.

The Zerg learned the lesson of being able to hollow out a wall and hit it like water from a dam. The first line of defense in the cave base was a bit far away from the passage, so enough buffer space was reserved.

This allowed the underground ratmen to rush out of the passage calmly, gather enough numbers, and quickly launch a powerful offensive.

The bodies of the underground ratmen are small, light, and flexible, which affects the killing efficiency of the defensive ground thorns.

The hydralisks in the Zerg base's defense line began to fire spike attacks, which together with the defensive spikes formed a frontal and underground three-dimensional attack. The killing efficiency immediately increased!

A large number of underground rat-men disappeared in the light. Their small bodies of flesh and blood were incomparable to the defensive capabilities of the ghouls.

But the underground rat-men are really fast. Even if they are crowded together, they will keep jumping and dodging in various weird postures. They are like a nest of fleas. When people see them, they will have a very strange feeling. Uncomfortable feeling.

Wu Qing's insect-man clone was in the cave space. When he saw this scene from the perspective of the insect-man's identity, he felt a sense of discomfort.

"Does this underground rat-man also have his own mental attack? Or is this scene too impactful?"

Wu Qing felt that with the strength of his mental power, ordinary mental attacks were ineffective against him. It must be that this scene was too weird, which caused him to have a strange feeling.

But he also thought about weirdness. With Weirdness's involvement, it was very possible that some weird and inexplicable things would come out.

Wu Qing simply withdrew the consciousness of the insect clone and observed the battlefield through the host blessed by the insect queen's spiritual power. As soon as his perspective was switched, his strange discomfort disappeared.

He looked at the battlefield again, and all he saw were some big rats jumping around vigorously, but in the end they could not escape the fate of extinction.

"It's weird and weird. This thing is really weird and hard to guard against. With my mental strength, I stood in the Zerg territory and watched the battle between the underground rats, and I was inexplicably caught!"

"I wonder if the weirdness here is too powerful? Or are all the weirdness in this world so scary?"

Wu Qing has been collecting weird information, but this thing seems to be a taboo. There is very little information circulated and recorded. The information he collected is all superficial and common sense.

The patrolling Zerg host detected that the strange thing that was very good at digging last night began to move around again.

According to the rules of conservation of matter and energy, changes to the material world require a corresponding price. Wu Qing does not believe that those weird things can continue to be dug out like this.

If he really had this ability, this weird thing could easily dig out a large amount of underground world, and the world would be in chaos.

Those weird people may have discovered that the Zerg tonight did not block the entrance of the passage, and did not dig a large space like last night. Instead, they quickly widened the passage, digging the passage where the underground ratmen rushed through into a broad and wide avenue to the sky. !

If the underground rat-men who first rushed out of the passage were like the water of a gurgling stream, then the underground rat-men who are now rushing out of the passage are like the overflowing floods of a mighty river.

A large number of underground rats rushed into the cave space. They did not crowd into a group and charge towards the Zerg base. Instead, they kept detouring to the safe areas on both sides, walking along the edge of the attack distance of the Zerg base's first line of defense, away from the passage. position before launching a charge towards the defense line of the Zerg base.

This expanded the front line to cover most of the cave base, which not only strengthened the offensive against the Zerg base, but also accelerated the gathering of the underground rats.

The defense buildings on the first line of defense of the Zerg base were on full fire, and more Hydralisks entered the defense line and joined the attack.

It seems that the offensive of the Underground Rats was not fierce enough and did not cause damage to the Zerg base. The strange ones began to dig and widen the cave space along the edge of the Zerg territory in order to gather more Underground Rats troops.

With the strange and rapid excavation, the territory occupied by the underground ratmen in the cave space is getting wider and wider.

The Underground Ratmen had enough space to display, and some strange Underground Ratmen began to come out of the passage. Compared to other Underground Ratmen, they had some more peculiar costumes.

Surrounding them were countless rats, all of which were really big rats that were sleek and weighed several kilograms.

As soon as they appeared, other underground rat-men gave way. The big black rats were like an endless river, pouring out in a steady stream. They were densely packed and layered, and soon they filled all the empty spaces. space.

Wu Qing's scalp felt numb as he looked at the tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of rats swarming around in this underground space.

If the system does not transform the corpses, these rat corpses alone will be able to cover the entire cave space with a thick layer. By then, the defensive thorns will not be able to pierce the underground ratmen walking on rats.

"squeak!"

"squeak!"

The strange underground rat-men who had brought the rat swarm all made some sharp screams. The originally calm rat swarm instantly boiled and they all rushed towards the Zerg territory!

A thick layer of black shadow spread towards the first line of defense of the Zerg base. The underground rats in front of them had all turned into light and disappeared. They rushed into the Zerg defense building without any hindrance along the way. scope.

The dense spikes pierced out, like bamboo shoots piercing out of a pile of gravel. Most of the mice were not directly attacked, but stepped on their companions' bodies, rising and falling with the spikes, like riding a roller coaster.

The mice's defense ability was extremely weak. A large number of mice that were directly pierced by the spikes turned into light and disappeared, making room for the mice rushing up from the back.

The hydralisk's spike attack, even if each attack could kill a bunch of mice, its overall killing efficiency was still reduced.

"This enemy's sea of rats tactics is better than the Zerg's sea of insects tactics. If it weren't for the evolution of the splash decomposition attack, it would be a bit troublesome to deal with this kind of enemy attack."

Wu Qing felt that many races in this world were very suitable for using various sea tactics. They were numerous, not afraid of death, and had strong organization. The conditions were really good.

In fact, the Zerg's sea of dogs tactics could solve most of the problems. At this time, the Zerg sent out the puppies, and the rats would definitely not be able to beat them. However, once a melee, facing such small mice, the attack efficiency of the hydralisk would be further affected.

It was still early, so as long as he could hold on, Wu Qing was not going to use the new attack method of splash decomposition attack.

The enemy on the opposite side was very cunning and smart, and had a strong learning ability. When the Zerg had something new, it would find a way to target it, and its tricks were endless, making it very difficult to deal with.
